summary: Contributions generated by LLMs and chatbots are banned in all parts of the project, including code, documentation, issues and artwork. Translating issue and comment text into English is the only exception.

evidence.quote: This project does not allow contributions generated by large languages models (LLMs) and chatbots.
This ban of AI generated content applies to all parts of the projects, including, but not limited to, code, documentation, issues, and artworks.
An exception applies for purely translating texts for issues and comments to English.
